title: Replace to Repeat
commonMistakes: Counting replacements as the number of characters that differ from the first character of the window
Shrinking the window only by one step instead of while it remains invalid
Forgetting that every position already counts as the majority letter, so zero replacements are needed for a single character
Assuming the answer always equals the whole string length
followUps: How can maintaining the maximum frequency avoid scanning 26 counters after every step?
What changes if replacements may turn a letter into any Unicode code point?
How would you return the substring rather than its length?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
